```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(sjPlot)
library(effectsize)
library(rstatix)

sessionInfo()

d <- read_csv("~/Box Sync/Lifting the Bar Materials & Data/LTB Data/LTB Online Teacher Study/Publishing_Data_Teacher_Study.csv")

str(d$prior_jd)
table(d$prior_jd)

d <-
  d %>% 
  mutate(prior_jd = as.factor(prior_jd),
         condition = as.factor(condition),
         cond_letterref = relevel(condition, "letter"),
         future_worry_positive_coded = future_worry_for_student_c3,
         future_worry_for_student_c3 = 8 - future_worry_for_student_c3)
```


```{r}
contrasts(d$condition)
```

# Specified Student in the Letter

## Commitment to Student
*Std. Alpha: 0.904; Scale 1-7 “Not at all” to “Extremely”*  

* How responsible would you feel for (name) as (he/she) returns to school?   

* How motivated would you feel to help (student) as (he/she) returns to school? 

* How committed would you feel to helping (student) succeed in returning to school?  

### Full Composite
```{r}
kable_styling(kable(describeBy(d$commitment_to_student_c3, d$condition, digits = 3, mat = T)))

commitment <- lm(commitment_to_student_c3 ~ condition + school_race_white, data = d)
commitment
cohens_d(commitment_to_student_c3 ~ cond_letterref, data = d)

AIC(commitment)
AIC(lmer(commitment_to_student_c3 ~ condition + (1|random_student_id) + school_race_white, data = d))

```


# Mixed Model Interactions 
## Data processing
```{r include=FALSE}
library(ggpubr)

d <- 
  d %>% 
  mutate(
    overall_success = rowMeans(
      select(., success_in_class_c5, success_in_school_c5, social_success_c4), na.rm = T),
    general_overall_success = rowMeans(
      select(., general_student_success_in_class_c5, general_success_in_school_c5, general_student_social_success_c4),
      na.rm = T))

# convert data into long format
dl <- 
  d %>% 
  select(condition, overall_success, general_overall_success, random_student_id, school_race_white, participant_id) %>% 
  rename(target_student = overall_success,
         students_in_general = general_overall_success) %>% 
  gather(key = "target", value = "rating", target_student, students_in_general) %>% 
  convert_as_factor(target)

dl <-
  dl %>% 
  mutate(cond_letterref = relevel(condition, ref = "letter"),
         target_studentref = relevel(target, ref = "target_student"))
levels(dl$condition)
levels(dl$cond_letterref)
levels(dl$target_studentref)
levels(dl$target)
```

Each chunk has:  
* summary statistics  
* box plot  
* linear model, DV: target student  
* linear model, DV: students in general  
* linear model interaction  

Between = condition  
Within = target  

Interpretation: https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/33709/interpreting-the-regression-output-from-a-mixed-model-when-interactions-between

## Analysis
cohen's d and CI for these interactions were calculated using Part 2: Comparison of Groups with Different Sample Sizes, via http://www.psychometrica.de/effect_size.html
```{r}
# Check summary stats
dl %>%
  group_by(condition, target) %>%
  get_summary_stats(rating, type = "mean_sd")

bxp <- ggboxplot(
  dl, x = "target", y = "rating",
  color = "condition", palette = "jco", title = "Overall Success"
  )
bxp

#### Interactions ####
# Control and Students in General as 0-level
int <- lmer(rating ~ condition*target + (1|participant_id) + school_race_white, data = dl)
summary(int)

# Letter as 0-level
summary(lmer(rating ~ cond_letterref*target+ (1|participant_id) + school_race_white, data = dl))

# Target Student as 0 level
model3 <- lmer(rating ~ condition*target_studentref + (1|participant_id) + school_race_white, data = dl)
summary(model3)

# Both Letter and Target Student as 0 level

model4 <- lmer(rating ~ cond_letterref*target_studentref 
               + (1|participant_id) + school_race_white, data = dl)
summary(model4)
```
